description: Crawl a website and extract its visual identity: the color palette measured on what the site shows (k-means in Lab space, each color with its share), the fonts and where each is served from, logos (inline SVG markup included), images with stock photos flagged, 3D and motion files, a surface/ink/accent theme and a Tailwind v4 @theme block. Same engine as https://mira.ssoac.com. The crawl runs from this machine, stays on the site's host, follows robots.txt by default and refuses private network addresses. Pass outputDir to also save the logos, images, tailwind.css and tokens.json to disk.

includeAssetData.description: Embed every logo and image as a base64 data URL in the response (default false: URLs only, which keeps the response small).

maxPages.description: Pages to crawl at most (default 10, 5 to 500). One page per template is sampled, so a few pages cover most sites.

outputDir.description: Absolute path of a new or empty folder to save the files in: logos/, images/, tailwind.css, tokens.json and report.json. A folder holding other files is refused, unless an earlier harvest wrote it.

render.description: Load the entry page in a headless Chrome installed on this machine. By default only when the static crawl comes back thin, as with sites built in JavaScript; true always renders (up to 30 s more), false never does. Skipped when no Chrome is found.

respectRobots.description: Follow robots.txt (default true). Turn off only for a site you own or operate.

saveMedia.description: With outputDir, also download the 3D models, animations and videos into media/ (default false; adds up to a minute or more).

url.description: The website to analyze, e.g. stripe.com or https://stripe.com/pricing

name: harvest_brand_identity
title: Harvest a brand identity
